kb.title: About COMP-EX
kb.answer: COMP-EX is the flagship B2C IT exhibition of the Vidarbha Computer & Media Dealers' Welfare Association (VCMDWA) — Central India's largest IT and technology expo. COMP-EX 2027 is the 33rd edition: laptops, printers, CCTV, networking, cybersecurity, AI, gaming and software from leading national and international brands, with seminars, career guidance, startup showcases and cyber-awareness programs. February 2027 · Dates to be announced, Civil Lines, Nagpur. Past editions drew around 2.5 lakh visitors and 200+ brands.

kb.title: About VCMDWA
kb.answer: COMP-EX is organised by the Vidarbha Computer & Media Dealers' Welfare Association (VCMDWA), Nagpur — founded in 1991, affiliated to FAIITA and FITAM, and Recognised as "Best IT Association" in India by DQ Week. It has 101 full members and 34 associate members from across Vidarbha. Executive team: Dinesh Naidu (President), Rohit Jaiswal (Vice President), Lalit Gandhi (Secretary), Sanjay Chaurasia (Joint Secretary), Jayanti Patel (Treasurer), Nikhil Gandhi (Executive Member), Mohit Parekh (Executive Member), Pratul Khandelwal (Executive Member), Altaf Chimthanawala (Executive Member).

kb.title: Who can exhibit or visit
kb.answer: Exhibitors: IT brands, distributors, dealers, system integrators, software companies, startups and service providers. Reserved for VCMDWA members — members get first preference for stall space. M1–M12 can be booked online with your membership number; M13–M24 are allotted by the stall committee. Visitors: open to everyone — citizens, students, professionals, MSMEs and businesses. Entry is free with an online registration.

kb.title: Why exhibit
kb.answer: COMP-EX puts your brand in front of lakhs of IT buyers from across Central India — home users, students, SOHO and corporate buyers, dealers and resellers. Launch new products, demo live, generate leads and sell on the spot over four full days, and get listed in the Digital COMP-EX Directory all year round.

kb.title: Why visit
kb.answer: See the latest laptops, desktops, printers, CCTV, networking, mobiles, gaming rigs and AI solutions from leading brands under one roof, compare and buy at expo offers, attend seminars and career sessions, and learn how to stay safe from cyber fraud. Entry is free: register once and your QR pass comes by e-mail and WhatsApp.

kb.title: Entry, pass and ID card
kb.answer: Visitor entry is free. Register online (or right here in the chat) and you get a personal QR pass by e-mail — and on WhatsApp — to show at the entrance for a quick check-in. Each family member can be registered on the same mobile number. Walk-ins can register at the gate by scanning the Entrance QR.

kb.title: Digital COMP-EX Directory
kb.answer: The Digital COMP-EX Directory lists every confirmed exhibitor with stall number, category, brands, phone, WhatsApp and directions — searchable during the expo and all year round. It is fully owned by COMP-EX / VCMDWA.

kb.title: Getting there
kb.answer: The venue is in Civil Lines, Nagpur, about 1.5 km from Nagpur Railway Station. Nagpur is served by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur Junction and Nagpur Metro. Free parking is usually provided for visitors.

kb.title: Show timings
kb.answer: COMP-EX 2027: February 2027 · Dates to be announced, 12:00 noon – 9:00 PM, all four days, at Civil Lines, Nagpur. Exhibitor set-up: 2 days before opening, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM (to be confirmed); move-out: Last day, after 9:00 PM (to be confirmed).

kb.title: What to expect
kb.answer: Highlights: Technology seminars and expert-led sessions; Career guidance and skill-development programs for students; Startup showcases and innovation platforms; Cyber awareness and digital literacy programs with Nagpur Police; Government e-Governance and public service initiatives; High-powered Gaming Zone; Launch platform for new products and services. The detailed programme will be announced closer to the dates.

kb.title: Gaming Zone and Food Court
kb.answer: Yes — COMP-EX has a high-powered Gaming Zone and a Food Court, both marked on the venue map. Spaces there are priced and allotted directly by the VCMDWA Stall Committee — call +91 97309 88800.

kb.title: Stall sizes and what's included
kb.answer: Sizes and rates (per stall, all four days): Brand Pavilion 6m × 6m (₹4,50,000); Premium Corner Stall 3m × 3m (₹95,000); Premium Stall 3m × 3m (₹75,000); Standard Shell Stall 3m × 3m (₹55,000); VCMDWA Member Stall 3m × 3m (₹45,000). Shell stalls include fascia signage, 1 table, 2 chairs and a power point; Brand Pavilions are island spaces on the main aisle. Extra electrical load must be requested in advance.

kb.title: More than one stall
kb.answer: Each online registration books one stall. For two or more stalls side by side, or a larger custom space, the VCMDWA Stall Committee books them for you under one name — call +91 97309 88800.

kb.title: What happens after booking
kb.answer: 1) Your stall is reserved as soon as you register and shows as pending. 2) You get an e-mail with your registration ID and the payment details, plus a WhatsApp message. 3) The stall committee reviews and confirms the booking. 4) After payment it is marked paid and the invoice is issued. You can check the status here with your mobile number.

kb.title: Paying for a stall
kb.answer: Stall payment is by bank transfer to VCMDWA's account. The exact amount and the account details are sent in your registration e-mail — or type the mobile number you registered with and tap “Payment details” to see them here.

kb.title: Cancellation and refund
kb.answer: Cancellations made before the registration deadline are eligible for a refund of any advance paid, as per VCMDWA terms. Cancellations after the deadline are non-refundable. To cancel or change a booking, call +91 97309 88800.

kb.title: Documents and rules for exhibitors
kb.answer: Documents: Valid government photo ID for all staff manning the stall; GST certificate / business registration proof (for invoicing); VCMDWA membership number (for Member Stalls). Guidelines: Stall fabrication must stay within your allotted footprint and height limit (2.5m unless approved otherwise). Electrical load beyond the standard power point must be requested in advance. Exhibitor badges must be worn at all times inside the expo. Demo equipment must be moved in only during the set-up window at the designated gate. All stall decor and banners must be fire-safety compliant.

kb.title: VCMDWA Member Stalls
kb.answer: Reserved for VCMDWA members — members get first preference for stall space. M1–M12 can be booked online with your membership number; M13–M24 are allotted by the stall committee. Rate ₹45,000 per stall (3m × 3m). For member bookings contact the VCMDWA Office on +91 97309 88800.

kb.title: Organisers and partners
kb.answer: Organised by the Vidarbha Computer & Media Dealers' Welfare Association (VCMDWA). Past associate partners include Government of Maharashtra and Maha-Metro. Media Partner: Hayat Computers & Security Solutions, Nagpur. For sponsorship opportunities, call +91 97309 88800.

kb.title: Venue layout
kb.answer: The live venue layout is on the Stalls page — every stall with its number and status (green = available). It also marks the entry, seminar stage, Gaming Zone and Food Court. I can show the empty stalls on the map right here too.

kb.title: Parking, stay and other arrangements
kb.answer: Visitor-friendly facilities usually include free parking, a food court and organised movement. Other arrangements will be shared closer to the dates — call the VCMDWA office on +91 97309 88800 or leave an enquiry here.

kb.title: Logo and listing
kb.answer: Confirmed exhibitors' logos appear in the “Our Exhibitors” slider on the home page and in the Digital COMP-EX Directory. You can upload your logo and up to 5 product images on the exhibitor form.

kb.title: Deadlines
kb.answer: Stall bookings close on 31 December 2026; visitors can register until the last day of the expo (walk-ins welcome). VCMDWA members get first preference; other stalls are allotted first come, first served.
